summary: Batch release of up to 30 owned sub-objects: walks two inline pointer arrays (25 slots starting at this+0x10, then 3 slots starting at this+0x74), and for each non-null slot dispatches the object's first vtable entry with argument 1 before nulling the slot. It then releases two single objects held at this+0xC and this+0xD8 the same way. All dispatch targets are fully indirect (no static callees). Returns the last release result. Counterpart to an allocation pass elsewhere.

operations.description: Point v2 at the first of the 25-slot pointer array at byte offset 0x10 (this[4]).
do-while over 25 slots of the array, advancing the slot pointer by one dword per iteration.
Guard on each slot being non-null before dispatching on it.
Dispatch vtable slot 0 (first vtable entry) on the object with argument 1, through the vtable pointer stored at the object base.
Null the released slot; this covers the first slot at byte offset 0x10 and each subsequent slot as the loop advances.
Point v5 at the first of the 3-slot pointer array at byte offset 0x74 (this[29]).
do-while over 3 slots of the array, advancing the slot pointer by one dword per iteration.
Guard on each slot being non-null before dispatching on it.
Dispatch vtable slot 0 (first vtable entry) on the object with argument 1, through the vtable pointer stored at the object base.
Null the released slot; this covers the first slot at byte offset 0x74 and each subsequent slot as the loop advances.
Guard on the single object at this+0xC (this[3]) being non-null before dispatching on it.
Dispatch vtable slot 0 on the object at this+0xC with argument 1.
Guard on the single object at this+0xD8 (this[54]) being non-null before dispatching on it.
Dispatch vtable slot 0 on the object at this+0xD8 with argument 1.
